text:
Marta - PM: Drafting a short product brief tying routing policies to launch gates for regulated customers. Sharing quick outline for feedback.
Ajay - Eng: Love it. Can we include a concise cost vs latency bucket table? Customers always ask that.
Devin - Architect: We should enumerate the main failure cases per routing mode: latency degradation, full region loss, and sudden surge/burst. Fallback semantics must be explicit.
Kevin - Sales: Two customers requested contractual isolation and residency last week. They need clear acceptance criteria for procurement.
Marta - PM: Plan: create a gating matrix mapping ask -> infra change -> acceptance metric -> rough dev effort. Also add a short runbook.
Sam - Security: Make KMS/HSM and audit retention non-negotiable for regulated pilots. Include on-prem HSM compatibility notes.
Ajay - Eng: Question: define "soft isolation" vs "hard isolation" migration path. Customers expect a path from affinity to dedicated pools.
Devin - Architect: Proposed taxonomy: soft-affinity, slice-affinity, dedicated-pool. Each has a routing policy plus documented fallback.
Kevin - Sales: Please add a cutover example I can use with procurement. They expect an operational narrative.
Marta - PM: Draft acceptance criteria (examples):
```
- Routing accuracy: 99.9% of traffic adheres to lane policy during steady state
- Failover: fallback path engages within 3s in 95% of injected region outages
- Cost: per-token overhead <= 2x baseline for dedicated pools (TBD in contract)
- Security: KMS integration + audit logs present for Private deployments
- Observability: per-route latency/cost dashboards + alerting
```
Ajay - Eng: Will add perf harness & sequence-length buckets. Also call out cache behavior differences.
Devin - Architect: Cache miss storms are a real risk for isolation modes; add mitigations and test scenarios.
Sam - Security: Include HSM firmware compatibility matrix early in the doc. Some customers run very old appliances.
Kevin - Sales: Suggested priority: 1) dedicated pools for top regulated customers, 2) soft-affinity for mid-market, 3) GA automation/tooling.
Marta - PM: Proposed timeline: Q3 pilot (single customer, single region) for dedicated pools; Q4 pilot for soft-affinity. OK?
Ajay - Eng: Q3 works if we reserve infra slots. @ops-bot please check availability.
ops-bot: infra-calendar: tentatively reserved 2xA100 for pilot window 2026-07-20 -> 2026-08-20.
Devin - Architect: I'll draft routing DSL examples and a backward-compatible migration sketch.
Marta - PM: I'll assemble a short brief + gating matrix and tag owners. Any objections?
Sam - Security: No objections; just want the HSM matrix in the first draft.
Kevin - Sales: I'll confirm pilot customers and align procurement expectations.
Ajay - Eng: We'll include perf and chaos tests in the PR.
Marta - PM: Thanks — I'll post the draft later today. :rocket:
